standard_prerequisites.name: Existence of a lift of a continuous map into a complete local ring along the quotient
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the section of the quotient map.

core_obligations: Derive formal smoothness of the residue field extension from separability (proof lines 9598-9600).
Put it into the adic form required by the lifting statement (proof lines 9600-9601).
Apply the lifting result to get the section (proof lines 9602-9605).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that if the residue field of a complete local algebra over a field is separable over that field, then the residue field embeds into the algebra as a section of the quotient map. The proof uses the characterisation of separable field extensions as formally smooth, upgrades that to formal smoothness for the adic topology on the residue field, and then applies the lifting result for continuous maps into complete local rings to obtain the required section.
